title: Bidirectional Mendelian randomization of gut microbiota and erectile dysfunction
description: Reproducible analysis code, provenance records, frozen summary results, manuscript files, and submission-grade figures for an error-controlled bidirectional Mendelian randomization study of gut microbial traits and erectile dysfunction. Third-party GWAS payloads are not redistributed.
